messages:
maria: FYI customer hit a 400 and the system called update_note instead of issue_refund. escalating.

maria: customer payload (redacted):
```json
{
  "customer_id": "C-93829",
  "amount_cents": 2500,
  "reason": "duplicate charge"
}
```

sam: ah, amount_cents vs amount. router schema validator probably failed and fallback matched update_note signature. can you paste the full API response?

maria: response body: `400 {"error":"tool_schema_mismatch","missing":"amount"}` and trace id `trace-77a1`

jay: looking at trace-77a1 in the router logs: `tool_choice=update_note, confidence=0.42, fallback_reason=schema_validation`

router-bot: log excerpt:
```
[2025-11-09T15:12:01Z] trace-77a1: request parsed, schema_check failed: missing required field 'amount'
[2025-11-09T15:12:01Z] trace-77a1: fallback search: best signature match 'update_note' (shared fields: customer_id, reason), score=0.42
[2025-11-09T15:12:01Z] trace-77a1: selected tool 'update_note' -> invoked
```

leah: customer says money didn't move — they're upset. ticket #INC-8241. I've asked for a screenshot but we have trace id already.

sam: repro steps I ran locally: sent same body to hosted endpoint -> got 400 + router picked update_note. quick test: changing `amount_cents` -> `amount` (number in cents) makes it pick issue_refund with confidence 0.91.

maria: thanks. do we think this is a router bug (too-permissive fallback) or a schema requirement we should relax?

jay: root cause: ambiguous overlap between tool signatures when required fields are missing. router currently does a best-effort signature match after schema fail. that behavior was intended to avoid dead-ends, but here it leads to wrong side effects.

sam: proposed short-term fix: if schema validation fails for a higher-impact tool (issue_refund, payout, capture_void), do NOT auto-fallback to destructive tools; instead return explicit 400 to caller with guidance (missing fields). i.e. tighten fallback policy for money-moving tools.

leah: agree. also want a customer-facing message we can send now explaining workaround: change key `amount_cents` -> `amount` or include `amount` field. I'll draft.

jay: long-term: add stricter signature distance metric and a blacklist of fallback targets for finance-related intents. also add telemetry flag to log these schema-fallback events into an alerting stream.

sam: I'll own the short-term patch and can push a canary today. will add an integration test that ensures schema-mismatch doesn't trigger money-moving tool. tagging @maria to update customer once canary is up. :eyes:

maria: thanks. pls also add a hotfix note in the incident channel if you roll it out. I'll add the customer ticket and share the trace id. :thumbsup:

leah: customer update posted: "Thanks — engineer told us to retry with `amount` key. We'll test and confirm."

jay: follow-up: added an immediate revert rule — router config now returns 400 for schema failures where the top candidate tool is in the finance_protected set. canary rolling to 10% at 15:13 UTC.

router-bot: rollout status: canary=10% healthy.

sam: pushed tests + patch to `router-service`, PR #4287. planning to promote to 100% after monitoring window.

maria: closing loop with customer once monitoring looks good. thanks all. :party_parrot:
notes: schema-fallback->wrong-tool; short-term policy change + canary deployed; customer notified
